description: This file defines the RssService class, an Android Service responsible for managing RSS feed updates, including querying feeds periodically, parsing RSS XML data, and notifying the user. It handles background operations related to RSS feed retrieval and update logic.

classes.name: RssService
classes.description: An Android Service class that manages periodic RSS feed updates, including network fetching, parsing, and storing feed data, as well as user notifications.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the service, sets up notifications, loads last check time, and starts the background thread for periodic updates.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Handles start commands, processing intent extras to trigger RSS query or add new RSS feed URLs.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources and cancels notifications when the service is destroyed.

methods.name: queryIfPeriodicRefreshRequired
methods.description: Determines whether it's time to requery RSS feeds based on the last check time and scheduled interval.

methods.name: queryRssItems
methods.description: Iterates over all configured RSS feeds, fetches updates if necessary, and updates the local cursor.

methods.name: queryItem
methods.description: Fetches, parses, and updates a single RSS feed given its URL.

methods.name: parseRssDocPubDate
methods.description: Extracts the pubDate from RSS XML data and converts it into a GregorianCalendar object.

methods.name: readRss
methods.description: Fetches the RSS feed content from a URL.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Callback to perform periodic checks for RSS feed updates.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Provides the Binder object for clients binding to the service.
